text: Another saying of Cato's was, that the Roman people did not only fix the value of such and such purple dyes, but also of such and such habits of life: "For," said he, "as dyers most of all dye such colors as they see to be most agreeable, so the young men learn, and zealously affect what is most popular with you."
author: Plutarch
speaker: Cato the Elder
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
